candidates.title: IHS-LM: Intra-batch Hybrid Scheduling and Layer Migration for VLM Pipeline Inference Acceleration on Edge Devices
candidates.reason: Heterogeneous edge pipeline-inference system combining KV-capacity-aware prefill/decode scheduling with bandwidth-aware layer migration to reduce pipeline imbalance.

candidates.title: Congestion-Aware Serving of Agentic LLM Applications
candidates.reason: Agentic LLM serving framework that adapts test-time compute to backend congestion; reports 77% tail-latency reduction versus static vLLM with bounded accuracy loss.

candidates.title: Unlocking Software-defined GPU Fabric Scheduling in the LLM Era
candidates.reason: Characterizes contention among PCIe/NVLink/RDMA traffic in LLM systems and proposes GPUWeaver for context-aware software-defined communication scheduling.

candidates.title: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Management and Serving for Robot Factories
candidates.reason: Multi-model multi-GPU VLA serving system with within-GPU stage disaggregation, SM control, placement and SLO-aware traffic management; reports large SLO-constrained load gains.

candidates.title: SemBridge: Compiling Consumer Observations into Cross-Stack Communication Plans
candidates.reason: Cross-stack communication planner for heterogeneous CUDA/NCCL and CANN/HCCL distributed-tensor systems; demonstrates >99.97% result-traffic reduction and throughput gains on Dense/MoE/MiniMax workloads.

discovery_stats.axis: forward citations of Splitwise for disaggregated LLM serving
